title: Normalization interface for clopen derived tensor restriction
statement: For an open immersion j:Y→X of schemes and a commutative ring sheaf R on the small pro-etale site of X, use the exact degreewise restriction and its canonical localization factorization. Write Comparison(j,R) for the natural isomorphisms from restriction of the native derived tensor to tensor of the restrictions. TotalNormalization fixes the ordinary comparison on local pure tensors and the total comparison on each generator. ModelNormalization(j,R,b,c) is the equality r_D(t_PQ) ≫ c_(QP,QQ) ≫ (κ_P ⊗ κ_Q) = κ_Tot ≫ Q(b_PQ) ≫ t_restricted on all flat-term K-flat pairs. Define braidedComparison and braidedUnit as the inverse tensor and unit maps of a specified braided structure, and unitComparison as canonical restriction of the degree-zero coefficient ring. These are the existing definitions extracted verbatim from lem-pur-clopen-kflat-monoidal-descent; no new mathematical construction or changed predicate is introduced. Dependencies are [lem-pur-clopen-unbounded-derived-localization], [lem-pur-clopen-total-tensor-kflat-detection], [lem-sf-ringed-derived-native-tensor], and [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal], together with the scheme, pro-etale site, sheaf-module, total tensor, flatness and K-flatness definitions in stmt_deps.
